WoW: Forever

Shadow Priest

"A vampiric DPS specialization, healing allies based on how much shadow damage they deal." Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. is here and nowhere else: the client makes it talent-only, 10 points into this tree. The published advice for the other two specs is to use these talents until you can heal in groups.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Shadow build has been tested. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. The one-point milestone talents are gated on points spent rather than on level: 11, 21 and 31 points as in Classic, now joined by a new 16-point milestone. ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form. is row 7, so level 40 and out of reach in the beta. No source has posted a level 30 build either: the cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, and no guide has recommended it. Blizzard's September 30, 2026 Class Deep Dive post is folded in below and takes priority over the three guide sites. Its own caveat applies: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Shadow is for

The damage a Priest does not otherwise get: Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.. The client makes it talent-only, gated on 10 points in the Shadow tree, and the single point grants all 6 spell ranks. No published Holy or Discipline build has it, so their rotations end in SmiteSmiteLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost20 ManaRange30 yd rangeSmite an enemy for 15 Holy damage., Mind BlastMind BlastLevel 10 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 9Cast1.5 sec castCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the target for 39 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat. and a wand.

The published ratings put Shadow at 3 out of 5 for levelling, the highest of the three Priest specs, and 2.5 for dungeons, the lowest of the three. The levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else. Shadow is slower than that sounds early on:

"Slow Starters, Better Later — In lower levels, Shadow has a complicated leveling curve. The spec is incredibly reliant on Spirit TapSpirit TapTalentCastInstant for its mana regeneration. Failing to get last hits on enemies will generally lead you to drinking more often."

It gets better twice, at known levels. At 25 the 16 points are in for Vampiric EmbraceVampiric EmbraceLevel 30 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost40 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration30 secAfflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.: party healing off your own Shadow damage, on a cooldown you can hold for the fights that need it. At 40, ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.'s 50% mana cut improves the mana curve "drastically."

Land the killing blow. Spirit TapSpirit TapTalentCastInstant is your mana economy, and it fires only when you kill something worth experience. Grey mobs do not count.

Your talent points

The two wand points are Discipline, which leaves 9 in Shadow at the very most, short of the 10-point gate either way.

Final 2 points: "there aren't a lot of good options: Twilight FocusTwilight FocusTalentCastInstantGives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell. if you find yourself playing mostly solo; BlackoutBlackoutTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantGives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec. if you're playing in a PvP environment; Shadow ReachShadow ReachTalentCastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.… for some extra range." Shadow ReachShadow ReachTalentCastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%. is now only 2 points for the same effect, down a row to row 2, so this option now buys the full talent instead of a partial rank.

Blizzard moved Shadow FocusShadow FocusTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%. up to row 1 and changed what it does: it now increases the chance for Shadow spells to hit, rather than reducing the target's chance to resist. The 5 points spent on it below buy Shadow hit chance.

Pain everything, then wand them down.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then critical strike, Hit, Intellect, Stamina, MP5.

Hit sits lower than you might expect while levelling: "While fighting enemies at your level, you'll need very little hit chance… Hit will take center stage when talking about endgame content." It sits lower still now that Shadow FocusShadow FocusTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%. grants Shadow hit chance directly from the talent tree, instead of its old job of lowering target resist. That talent is row 1, 5 points, and the first pick in the build above.

What Forever changed for Priests

  • Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. is talent-only, as it was in Classic. The client's talent table carries it as the Shadow tree's one-point talent, and no trainer teaches it. What Forever changed is the damage: 63 at rank 1, from 75. The client puts the gate at 10 points in Shadow rather than at your spec, so a Holy or Discipline Priest can dip for it. No published Holy or Discipline build reaches it, and their rotations contain no Mind Flay at all.
  • Shadow FocusShadow FocusTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%. moved from row 2 to row 1, and now increases Shadow spell hit chance instead of reducing the target's resist chance. See Stat priority above.
  • Shadow ReachShadow ReachTalentCastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%. moved from row 4 to row 2, and now costs only 2 points for the same range bonus.
  • Improved Mind FlayImproved Mind FlayTalentCastInstantYour Mind Flay now deals 20% more damage, gains 10 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by 80%. (new, row 3, requires Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.): increases Mind Flay's damage and range, but reduces how much it slows the target's movement. That is Blizzard's wording. The client's tooltip instead deepens the slow, to 80% against Mind Flay's own 50%, alongside 20% more damage and 10 yards more range.
  • Shadow AffinityShadow AffinityTalentCastInstantReduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%.'s threat reduction on Shadow spells increased slightly.
  • Shadow WeavingShadow WeavingTalentCastInstant is now a personal stacking buff rather than the raid-wide Shadow Vulnerability debuff. Blizzard adds "Percentage increase to damage decreased moderately", with no figure attached to it. The buff always lands on you, but it no longer feeds other Shadow casters or Warlocks, so do not take a raid assignment on it.
  • Devouring ContagionDevouring ContagionTalentCastInstantReduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration. (new, row 5): cuts Devouring PlagueDevouring PlagueLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost215 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration24 secAfflicts the target with a disease that causes 128 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.'s Mana cost, and when a target dies while afflicted, Devouring Plague jumps to a new enemy within 5 yards carrying its remaining duration. Blizzard's post is the source for 5 yards; the client's tooltip reads 10.
  • Early DemiseEarly DemiseTalentCastInstantIncreases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%. (new, row 6, needs 25 Shadow points): raises Shadow Word: DeathShadow Word: DeathLevel 32 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost175 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownA word of dark binding that inflicts 295 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 10% of your maximum health.'s critical strike chance against targets under 20% health, and only under that threshold. Moot for now; see below.

Improved Psychic ScreamImproved Psychic ScreamTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec. now requires BlackoutBlackoutTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantGives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec. instead.

At level 60

Unknown: whether Shadow has a raid slot at all. Losing the Shadow Vulnerability debuff role removes what it was for in Classic, and what is left is single-target damage plus a Vampiric EmbraceVampiric EmbraceLevel 30 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantCost40 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration30 secAfflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. that heals only the party.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
